settings.label: Enabled
settings.description: Show RETROARCH on the main menu.

settings.label: Playlist Folder
settings.description: Where RetroArch playlists (.lpl files) live. Default: ~/.config/retroarch/playlists

settings.label: ROM Folder
settings.description: Where ROM files live. Used to resolve relative paths in playlists. Default: ~/ROMs

settings.label: Thumbnail Display
settings.description: Show thumbnails to the left or right of the game list, or disable.

settings.label: RetroArch Executable
settings.description: Path to RetroArch binary. Leave empty to use 'retroarch' from PATH.

settings.label: Playlist Sort
settings.description: How the playlist list is ordered. [SYSTEM] By short system name (default)  [ALPHA] Raw playlist filenames  [COMPANY] Alpha by the manufacturer prefix
